tiers.lit: colour plus additive light, translucent volumes
tiers.strict: limited palette, banded light, binary alpha

effects.name: Arcane beam
effects.description: Spiked source orb, a banded beam whose width churns locally with spiral strands, one bright node per loop that runs down the core and bursts at a spiked impact crown that throws sparks back. Seamless loop.

effects.name: Arcane orb projectile
effects.description: A small bright magenta orb charges from spiralling rune motes, flies trailing satellite motes and a smooth tapering ribbon that cools pink to deep violet, bursts in one white frame of core and short rays, then a thin broken ring opens and dots out while + sparkles twinkle and linger.

effects.name: Blink dash
effects.description: A slit swallows the figure, one designed smear frame crosses with stepped afterimages, a white arrival peak, motes linger at both ends.

effects.name: Blink out
effects.description: The figure's space folds into vertical streaks that pinch to a bright line, flash white once, and the line snaps upward and away, leaving a collapsing ring, drifting rune motes and a fading floor glyph.

effects.name: Magic circle summon
effects.description: An inner ring draws on, the outer ring and runes counter-rotate in holds, a pillar of light peaks white once, the runes lift off as glyph specks and the rings break into dashes.

effects.name: Portal summon
effects.description: A rune band draws itself around a floor ellipse, the floor tears open on one white frame, a lobed column of energy erupts, twists, splits open and slumps back in; the hole pinches shut and the band breaks into drifting arcs and motes.

effects.name: Rune trap
effects.description: A dormant teal floor seal lights its runes one by one, fires a jagged spike of light (one white frame) that throws tumbling rune-glyph shards, collapses into a falling spark shower, then cracks and erodes from its ends while two shards linger and blink out.

effects.name: Shield shatter
effects.description: A hex-faceted violet dome is hit from the left, cracks, flashes white along its cracks for one frame, then breaks into spinning angular glass shards that arc right, fall and taper to chips while its base ring hollows away.

effects.name: Teleport in
effects.description: Motes and streaks converge onto the spot as a floor glyph tightens, a slit of light opens and flashes white once, widens into a body-sized column that peels away in upward-sweeping bands, and sparkles and a ground shimmer fade last.

effects.name: Arcane burst
effects.description: A violet charge curls five streaks inward, bursts on one white frame into a leaning magenta star-flower with a broken rune ring and spiralling shards; the petals hollow into curled crescents and dashes while glints fade to plum.

effects.name: Big explosion
effects.description: One white peak, a lobed fireball that cools white to red, smoke that rises and hollows, debris arcs and a ground dust ring.

effects.name: Fire nova
effects.description: One-shot radial fire nova around a caster: embers sucked into a hot ground core, one white burst, then a thick lobed wall of flame tongues runs out along a perspective floor ellipse (tall near, short and dark far), leans out and tears its tips, hollows and cools from the inside over glowing cinders, breaks into burning patches, then embers, char dashes and smoke.

effects.name: Firework burst
effects.description: A rocket spark climbs, hangs, and bursts on one white frame into uneven magenta-gold comet streamers that arc down under gravity and crackle into twinkling sparkles, with willow drips falling last.

effects.name: Implosion
effects.description: A black void with a hot lobed rim opens and drags dust and sparks inward, crushes to a held bead, flashes once in its own shape, and releases a thick lobed ring, an echo ring and smoke that hollow away.

effects.name: Small explosion
effects.description: One white flash, four lobes that roll out and cool to smoke, flung debris, puffs that hollow and lift, a scorch mark.

effects.name: Campfire
effects.description: Seamless campfire loop: crossed logs lit on their fire side, a coal bed, leaning flame tongues of different heights where the tall one tears off a teardrop once per loop, rising embers on varied periods, and a soft light pool on the ground in the lit tier.

effects.name: Fire pillar
effects.description: A ground crack heats up, a column of fire erupts with one white-yellow peak, fat tongues lick up and tear off the top, then the pillar collapses into rising embers, dark smoke curls and a scorched patch that cools.

effects.name: Fire tornado
effects.description: Seamless fire-tornado loop: a leaning open funnel of two torn flame ribbons climbing a spiral (bright front ribbons over deep-red back ribbons seen through the gaps), licks streaming off in the spin direction, swept ground-fire arcs, tongues tearing off its edges and hollowing as they rise, a swirling ring of ground fire flinging embers, embers spiralling up, and once per loop a flare climbing the funnel that throws a big tongue off the top.

effects.name: Fireball impact
effects.description: Fireball travel loop with lobed trailing tongues, a squash on contact, one white impact frame, a lobed fire burst that hollows into crescents and cools to maroon, debris specks.

effects.name: Flamethrower
effects.description: Seamless flamethrower jet blowing right: cream core at the nozzle, an orange body of rolling lobes, fat lobes tearing off the far end and curling into dark smoke, embers spitting forward; two gouts per loop surge down the jet.

effects.name: Ground flames
effects.description: Seamless burning-ground hazard loop: four lobed flame clumps along a scorched perspective ellipse (near clumps tall and bright, far clumps short and dark) whose tongues lick and tear off rising tips, glowing cinders on a char patch, embers on varied periods, and once per loop the tallest clump flares and throws a separate flame tongue.

effects.name: Lava burst
effects.description: The ground bulges and its cracks glow, one white peak bursts it open, a heavy lava fountain throws fat blobs on ropes that arc and splat into pools; the pools crust over from the edges, their cracks glow last, and dark wisps rise as they die.

effects.name: Meteor strike
effects.description: A rock falls diagonally with a lit leading rim and a tongued flame trail, one white impact frame, a lobed fire dome, a ground shockwave and bouncing chunks, smoke that rises and hollows, a cooling crater and embers.

effects.name: Angel feathers
effects.description: A chunky tilted golden halo torus flares over the head, flashes white once and bursts quill feathers that spiral out in three drifts, then rock down like falling feathers, tumbling and cooling cream to amber, while golden motes twinkle and the halo shrinks and hollows away.

effects.name: Barrier block
effects.description: A hexagonal light pane snaps in, takes a hit from the right in one white frame, ripples a flash through its hex cells, cracks, and dissolves cell by cell into falling gold motes.

effects.name: Divine beam
effects.description: A faint sliver and a broken floor halo build, then a heavy notched column of light slams down with one white ground-hit frame and a flat starburst; it holds with climbing streaks and descending rings, then narrows into three slivers that break into rising dashes and motes while the halo hollows last.

effects.name: Holy heal
effects.description: Ground glint, floor ring, rising rods pulled into a star, one white pillar frame that breaks into banded light shafts, ascending crosses, plus sparkles that blink out.

effects.name: Holy smite
effects.description: A golden-white pillar slams down in two frames, one white peak with a domed splash, a thick broken halo ring and a cross scorch on the floor; the column collapses top-down into broad rising light shards while feathers tumble up.

effects.name: Regen aura
effects.description: Seamless health-regeneration status loop: a low broken ellipse of green light at the feet (bright near arc, dim far arc), three twisting wisps of light rising off it, chunky shaded crosses and leaf motes riding the wisps up that sway, shrink and hollow as they fade, and once per loop a big cross that pulses bright and pops into four motes.

effects.name: Resurrect
effects.description: A golden floor sigil draws itself, a beam with a ray-broken top descends onto it, one white peak, then the beam hollows into rails and dashes while feathers and sparkles rise gold to pale amber to dusky rose and the sigil breaks up from the inside last.

effects.name: Shield bubble
effects.description: Seamless holy shield loop: a sphere shell with a bright gold rim on the lit upper left and a thin far rim behind the character, hexagon facets shimmering in a travelling band, orbiting motes, and once per loop a strike that sends a ripple across the shell.

effects.name: Blizzard
effects.description: Seamless localized snowstorm: wind-driven snow slanting down-right in far, mid and near depth bands grouped into gusts, two broad pale gust ribbons, a churning snow-mist drift on the ground, and once per loop a gust swell where the snow thickens and a ribbon tears off.

effects.name: Freeze encase
effects.description: Ice teeth grow up around a character footprint into a faceted block that glints white once, holds, cracks and shatters into falling shards over a frost patch that fades last.

effects.name: Frost breath
effects.description: Seamless cone of cold blowing right: a dense pale root, rolling vapour lobes with lit tops and deep-blue undersides that slow, curl back into crescents and break up, tumbling 2x2 ice chips and glints; once per loop a shard cluster forms at the far end, flashes and shatters.

effects.name: Frost nova
effects.description: Converging motes, an empty beat, a white eruption of faceted ice crystals on a floor ring, a hold, a crack, then large shards that fly and fall while the ice floor cracks into segments.

effects.name: Ice spike
effects.description: Frost spreads under the target, a big faceted ice crystal with three side shards shoots up and flashes white, holds, then cracks and shatters into tumbling shards and frost mist over a lingering frost patch.

effects.name: Ice wall
effects.description: Frost creeps along the ground, a staggered row of jagged faceted ice slabs erupts into a wall, glints white once, holds under curling frost mist, then shatters from the top down into tumbling shards while the stumps sink and the frost fades from its ends.

effects.name: Snowball impact
effects.description: A lumpy shaded snowball arcs in shedding powder puffs, squashes on the target, flashes white once as a packed mass of chunks, then the chunks fly and fall into melting slush while a cold powder cloud billows and hollows and ice glints twinkle.

effects.name: Blood splat
effects.description: A crimson pop, then a big fan of blood with a pale lit rim and tapered spurts holds for three frames, hollows from inside into a sagging crescent that breaks into dashes, while heavy drops arc down and land as puddles that outlast the splash.

effects.name: Crit hit
effects.description: Inward pinch, one white jagged starburst cut by a diagonal slash, chunky shards and a broken tilted shock ring cooling to deep red.

effects.name: Ground slam shockwave
effects.description: One white crack-flash on the floor, a flattened shockwave ring that breaks into arcs, thrown earth chunks that bounce once, dust that rolls out and hollows, cracks that fade.

effects.name: Hit spark
effects.description: Needle, one white peak frame, a long X and broken ring that cool down the ramp, embers that scatter and vanish.

effects.name: Parry
effects.description: Contact needle, one white cross-glint peak, a steel ring that breaks into arcs, sparks that arc up, cool and fall.

effects.name: Punch hit
effects.description: Squashed pinch, one white uneven comic-burst star, a hollow jagged ring of the same spikes, thick wedges knocked right and dust chips that drop.

effects.name: Rock shatter
effects.description: A faceted boulder struck from above-left cracks, flares pale cream along its cracks for one frame with a low dust burst, then breaks into eight faceted chunks that tumble, bounce once and shrink away, while two light dust puffs hollow into crescents and a dust smear lingers on the ground.

effects.name: Shockwave ring
effects.description: A clean perspective shockwave ring for landings and heavy blows: white contact flash, a thick near-bright ring that thins and breaks into arcs and dashes, a band of dust and air distortion, fading cracks.

effects.name: Ball lightning
effects.description: A crackling plasma orb with flickering jagged tendrils flies left to right, trailing a broken afterimage and spat sparks, then discharges in one white frame: six forked bolts and a ring of static that break into dashes and jittering motes fading to violet.

effects.name: Chain lightning
effects.description: A bolt hops left to right across three targets in quick succession; each hop strikes as a forked white-cored arc with a spiky burst, while earlier arcs flicker, break into dashes and crumble into specks.

effects.name: Lightning strike
effects.description: Leader, one white peak strike with a spike crown, re-strikes every 3 frames on fresh paths, fork afterimages, a chain arc to a second target, squiggle residue.

effects.name: Static burst
effects.description: Bold angular bolts stab inward, then one white frame of a large spiky burst mass firing five thick tapered zigzag bolts; the bolts break into angular fragments and short angular sparks that cool white -> cyan -> blue -> indigo over a crumbling indigo residue.

effects.name: Thunder cloud
effects.description: Seamless storm-cloud hazard loop: dark slate lobes churn over slanted two-depth rain that splashes on the ground below; once per loop the underside flashes from inside and a jagged forked bolt strikes the ground, with a ground flash, sparks and a scorch.

effects.name: Axe smear
effects.description: A heavy overhead axe chop: a thick steel crescent smear arcs down over three frames with a white, warm-edged leading rim and breaks into chunky fragments and sparks where it lands.

effects.name: Hammer smash
effects.description: A heavy overhead hammer blow: a thick earth-toned crescent smear lands on the ground, one chunky white-cored ground burst, a perspective shockwave that breaks into arcs, cracks, kicked-up rock chips, rolling dust billows and a lingering dust bank.

effects.name: Shadow claw
effects.description: A three-claw shadow rake swiped down-right: three tapered violet crescents land a frame apart, flash once over a dark burst, then hollow tail-first into dashes while dark wisps curl up.

effects.name: Spear thrust
effects.description: A straight spear lunge: a tapered steel wedge smear with a warm-white head and parallel speed streaks, a star burst at the tip, then the smear hollows from the rear into dashes.

effects.name: Sword combo
effects.description: Three crescent slashes in quick succession: down, rising reverse, and a heavy horizontal finisher with a spark burst.

effects.name: Acid spit
effects.description: A lumpy, glowing gob of acid is spat along a shallow arc, dripping droplets and shedding a beaded trail, splats against a wall on one pale peak frame, throws a crown of thick tapered tongues back, and leaves a sizzling puddle whose bubbles pop and fumes hollow away before it shrinks, darkens and is gone.

effects.name: Acid splash
effects.description: A glob lands and bursts into a crown of acid droplets that arc and splat; the puddle bubbles and fumes, then evaporates to nothing.

effects.name: Bloom heal
effects.description: A sprout pushes out of a soil crack, unfurls two leaves and a bud that blooms into a six-petal flower with one pale peak; a pollen puff and green healing motes spiral up, the petals detach and tumble away, the stem wilts back into the ground and the grass tufts follow.

effects.name: Boulder toss
effects.description: A faceted, mossy boulder tumbles along a shallow arc trailing dust, lands in one white dust-crown frame, cracks into four dark-rimmed chunks that bounce once and sink, while a forward-skewed dust ring and a low, warm, broad-lobed dust cloud spread and hollow away.

effects.name: Earth spike row
effects.description: A fissure splits the floor, six faceted rock spikes punch up in a quick staggered row, hold, then crack along seams, slide apart, shatter into chunks and sink back into the ground under hollowing dust.

effects.name: Ground fissure
effects.description: A jagged, branching crack races along the ground, opening into a glowing gap as slabs tilt up beside it; one orange-yellow burst when it reaches the end, then dust plumes hollow, grit falls, the slabs settle and the glow cools and closes.

effects.name: Leaf storm
effects.description: Leaves spiral in from the edges into a spinning knot that bursts in one pale flash as a fan of lime wind-slash crescents aimed right; the leaves ride the crescents out, flutter down with sway, settle and fade while the crescents hollow into dashes.

effects.name: Poison cloud
effects.description: Seamless lingering poison gas loop: a ground-hugging cumulus of shaded green-and-purple lobes that churns in place, with bubbles popping inside it and skull-shaped wisps rising off it and dissolving.

effects.name: Spore burst
effects.description: A fungal puffball squashes and bursts: a dense ochre-and-olive spore cloud billows up in a few big shaded lobes, hollows from the inside into drifting spore motes, and leaves a few glowing spores and a brief ground stain.

effects.name: Vine snare
effects.description: The ground cracks, four thick vines whip up and coil around the target, lock in one green-gold flash, grip, then wither to brown, break into chunks and sink, leaving clods and a fading scar.

effects.name: Arrow impact
effects.description: A wooden arrow flies in on a short pale wind streak, thunks into a surface with one white chip-star frame, quivers and settles while a warm dust puff curls up and hollows and splinters arc down, then darkens to a silhouette and breaks into dashes.

effects.name: Ice shard
effects.description: A faceted ice crystal launched from a frost puff flies right on a thin cold streak shedding frost motes, rams the target, flashes white once and shatters into faceted fragments, frost mist and a rime splat that cool and break up.

effects.name: Magic missile
effects.description: Arcane orb: gather, flight on an S path dragging a long twisting ribbon that ends in a dotted thread, a squash, one white flash frame, a hot disc that opens into a thin ring with radial streaks, + sparkles that outlive it.

effects.name: Poison dart
effects.description: A small barbed dart streaks in trailing toxic droplets and a curling vapour wisp, bursts into one white-green splat star, throws a splash of tapered droplets and leaves a bubbling toxic patch that pops, hollows and fades.

effects.name: Curse
effects.description: Violet-black wisps coil up around the target and knot into a cloaked skull that flashes once, then its drapes let go, sink into the target as crescents and dashes, and motes drift up.

effects.name: Shadow bolt
effects.description: A writhing violet-black smoke bolt with a magenta-white core flies right trailing curling tendrils that pinch off; on impact a magenta flash and a splash of dark tendrils and curling smoke that sink and dissolve into motes.

effects.name: Shadow tendrils
effects.description: A shadow pool spreads and five glossy liquid-shadow tentacles erupt, curl in and clench over a point above it with one magenta-white flash, then let go, unwind and sink back tip first as crescents and dashes while smoke peels off and the pool hollows into a ragged ring.

effects.name: Soul drain
effects.description: Pale teardrop souls are torn out of a target and stream left on wavy staggered paths into a small dark vortex at the caster, which flares once when the biggest lands, then closes into crescents and dashes while the target's wisps hollow out.

effects.name: Void implosion
effects.description: Violet arms and debris spiral into a black core with a sickly rim, it holds, pops on one white frame, and wisps and curse motes drift off.

effects.name: Dash dust
effects.description: A dash/skid dust: billows kick back and up from the start foot, a low dust streak and speed lines trail along the ground, and a smaller spray curls forward at the skid end; they hollow into crescents and dashes while grit falls.

effects.name: Dust puff
effects.description: A landing dust puff: soft scalloped billows roll out along the ground and rise, thin into crescents and round puffs; grit flicks out low.

effects.name: Smoke bomb
effects.description: A ninja smoke bomb: a pellet lands and pops white, a low wide cloud of six shaded grey-violet lobes billows out, churns, and thins from the inside into crescents, wisps and curls over a lingering ground haze.

effects.name: Steam vent
effects.description: A hissing steam vent loop: soft shaded puffs rise from a small glowing floor crack, lean, swell and hollow into crescents and wisps; once a loop a tall jet hisses up and throws droplets that arc back down.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.description: Seamless bleeding status loop on an implied body: three wounds bead and swell drops that stretch into teardrops, snap free and fall as streaks, splat into small crowns on an implied ground line and spread into puddle marks that fade, near marks larger and brighter; once per loop the rib wound spurts a short arc of droplets.

effects.name: Burning aura
effects.description: Seamless burning status loop: shaded flame tongues around an empty character footprint that pinch off into rising wisps which hollow and cool to violet, an ember stream on varied periods, a faint heat ring at the feet; in the lit tier a firelit smoke plume that the tongue tears feed.

effects.name: Charm hearts
effects.description: Seamless charmed status loop: four chunky shaded hearts bob and rock round a tilted orbit over the head, big and bright in front, small and dark behind the crown, with a sparkle trail and one pulse-and-glint beat that puffs out rising heart motes.

effects.name: Electrified
effects.description: Seamless shocked status loop: jagged 2 px-cored arcs crawl and flicker over a character's outline, one big arc snaps across the body per loop and leaves a short afterimage, and sparks spit off and fall.

effects.name: Frozen chill
effects.description: Seamless chilled/slowed status loop: faceted ice crystals crusting the feet that glint in turn, designed snowflakes drifting down on their own sway, one cold breath puff per loop that hollows into a crescent, and a faint lacy frost patch on the floor.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.description: Seamless poison status loop wrapping an empty character footprint: two tall toxic vapour tongues rise from a lumpy ooze ring up each flank, joined by a darker belt behind the body; bubbles ride up the tongues and pop, drips splat on a soaked stain; once per loop a big bubble bursts with a splash and a tongue tip swells into a skull wisp that tears off and dissolves.

effects.name: Power-up aura
effects.description: Seamless powered-up status loop: golden energy flames licking up from a ground ellipse and tearing off into teardrops, darker thin wisps behind the body and bright ones in front, a segmented ground ring that pulses in pieces, rising motes, and once per loop a ring of light sweeping feet to head that pops into four sparkles.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.description: Seamless asleep status loop: chunky shaded Z glyphs drift up and right on uneven sways, grow, tilt and hollow away, with one sleep-bubble beat per loop that inflates, pops and throws droplets.

effects.name: Stun stars
effects.description: Seamless dazed status loop: four bevelled five-point stars tumble round a tight tilted orbit over the head, big and pale in front, small and cooled behind, on a clean orbit ring whose comet trails cool to violet behind a head gap, with one sparkle beat per loop.

effects.name: Coin pickup
effects.description: Gold glint, one white star peak, a ring of twinkling four-point sparkles that cool and scatter, specks that drift down.

effects.name: Heart pickup
effects.description: A chunky heart squashes, pops up and bursts in one white frame; a pink ring breaks into dashes while tiny heart and plus motes rise and cool.

effects.name: Level up
effects.description: Floor glint, a gold ring sweeping feet to crown with rising light streaks, one white crown flash, then climbing chevrons, twinkling glints and a lingering floor ring.

effects.name: Star-burst pickup
effects.description: A gold five-point star squashes, stretches and spins edge-on, flashes one white four-point frame, then sprays tumbling mini stars that arc down and cool while a broken ring of gold dashes expands.

effects.name: Treasure glint
effects.description: Looping pickup glint: one chunky four-point hero star that grows to a white beat and hollows into a ring and dashes, with smaller stars popping on staggered beats.

effects.name: Bubble burst
effects.description: Four wobbling water bubbles swell; the largest pops on one white frame into droplet wedges and a foam ring, the others pop in turn with droplets that arc and fall, and the foam ring breaks into dashes.

effects.name: Tidal wave
effects.description: A swell rises, curls a foam-lipped wave that rolls right and crashes on one white foam frame, then breaks into spray and a spreading puddle whose foam line drains away.

effects.name: Water geyser
effects.description: A wet patch bubbles, then a wavering water column blasts up under a churning foam crown that bursts white on the peak, sprays droplets, collapses top-down as a curtain of falling drops and splashes, and leaves a pool that drains into a broken ring.

effects.name: Water splash
effects.description: A drop hits the water: a ragged crown cup flares on one white frame, tears open around a rising central jet, flings droplets that arc and splat, and the puddle ring spreads, breaks into dashes and fades.

effects.name: Whirlpool
effects.description: Seamless ground whirlpool loop: ragged spiral arms with lit foam crests and deep shadow sides rotate inward round a dark eye, foam flecks are flung off the rim and pulled back, and once per loop a near-side crest rears up and splashes.

effects.name: Whirlwind
effects.description: Seamless whirlwind loop: a swaying funnel of pale grey-green crescent bands sliding around it, near arcs pale and thick over deep thin far arcs, orbiting leaves and pebbles, a whirling tan dust skirt, and once per loop a leaf flung out.

effects.name: Wind blade
effects.description: A thrown crescent of compressed air: a thick pale-green blade with two fading echo crescents and leaves sucked along in its wake, one white flash of the blade with a thin cut line through the target, then the blade splits into two curling halves that break into dashes while a puff of air rings out.

effects.name: Wind gust
effects.description: A one-shot horizontal gust: curling white-teal wind ribbons with torn leaves tumbling through.
